issues.explanation: No change to routes/* is in the diff, so there is no evidence the entity.members route itself authorizes manager-only access; only Members::mount() authorizes. A GET could still be served if the route does not re-check.
Public Livewire endpoints that mutate component state do not authorize on the server, violating the every-action-must-authorize rule (low impact since only UI state).
Race handling only maps SQLSTATE 23000 with unique/duplicate in the message, so a Postgres unique violation (23505) would re-throw as a 500 instead of becoming an error on inviteEmail.
The invite form has no explicit @error/help is-danger block for inviteEmail in the diff; the exactly-once error requirement therefore relies on <x-input> internals with no visible evidence.

review.summary: The change implements invite-only membership, the PendingInvites flow, queued invite mail, and manager-only member modals with thorough Pest coverage and docs. It needs changes before merging because the entity.members route gate has no evidence in the diff and there are small Livewire/DB-portability gaps.
